findings.summary: Implementer used the wrong branch prefix (agents/ vs agent/) three times before self-correcting.

evidence.note: 3 failed `git checkout -b agents/312-*` calls, then a successful `agent/312-*`.

proposed_change.detail: Document the agent/<ticket>-<slug> convention in team memory so implementers stop re-deriving it.
proposed_change.risk_if_wrong: Wrong branch prefix could break the strip-attribution action's branch scan.

findings.summary: Implementer guessed underscored schema filename before finding hyphenated form.

evidence.note: Two failed reads of schemas/miner_findings.schema.json, then a hit on the hyphenated name.

proposed_change.detail: State that schemas/ files use hyphenated names, not underscored.
proposed_change.risk_if_wrong: Rule too broad if applied outside schemas/.

findings.summary: Implementer tried git checkout on shared checkout four times before switching to worktree.

evidence.note: Four `git checkout <branch>` attempts on the shared checkout, each aborted, before a `git worktree add` call succeeded.

proposed_change.detail: Load the worktree convention into implementer context by default.
proposed_change.risk_if_wrong: Overhead if agent already loads it from CLAUDE.md.
